title: ProgramDistill: From Interactive Web Apps to Verifiable Reference-Guided SWE Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.18805v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents are typically evaluated with desired behavior specified through issues or instructions. In practical web development, however, agents may need to infer behavior from working software and implement it in an incomplete application. We introduce ProgramDistill, a benchmark evaluating coding agents on features discovered through interaction with fully functional reference applications. We build ProgramDistill by factorizing applications into features of different granularities, each associated with replayable behaviors executable via its gold patch. Our pipeline, mine-craft-patch, discovers 1,975 replay-verified behaviors across 26 applications and constructs 4,063 tasks without human intervention. Across nine frontier coding agents, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 achieve 49.2% and 28.8% success on cumulative workflows in full-application reconstruction. In partial-application reconstruction, success falls from 100% to 64.0% a

translated_title: ProgramDistill：从交互式网络应用到可验证的参考引导式软件工程任务
translated_abstract: 编码智能体通常通过issue或指令所指定的期望行为来进行评估。然而，在实际的网页开发中，智能体可能需要从可运行的软件中推断出行为，并将其实现到一个不完整的应用程序中。我们提出了ProgramDistill，这是一个评估编码智能体的基准，测试其通过与功能完备的参考应用程序进行交互来发现特性的能力。我们通过将应用程序分解为不同粒度的特性来构建ProgramDistill，每个特性都与可通过其黄金补丁执行的可重放行为相关联。我们的流水线mine-craft-patch在26个应用程序中发现了1,975个经重放验证的行为，并构建了4,063个任务，全程无需人工干预。在九个前沿编码智能体的评估中，GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5在全应用重建的累积工作流中分别达到49.2%和28.8%的成功率。在部分应用重建中，成功率从100%下降到64.0%。
tldr: ProgramDistill提出了一个无需人工干预的自动化流水线，通过将功能完备的参考应用分解为可重放验证的特性，构建了四千多个参考引导式软件工程任务，用于评估编码智能体从可运行软件中推断行为并实现到不完整应用的能力。
